questions.stem_text:
What is the dimensionality of the null space of the following matrix? A = [[1, 1, 1], [1,
1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]
questions.answer_explanation: The null space of the matrix A consists of all vectors that, when multiplied by A, yield the zero vector, and since A has rank 1 (as all rows are linearly dependent), the dimension of the null space, given by the formula dimension = number of columns - rank, is 2 (3 - 1 = 2).

questions.stem_text: The disadvantage of Grid search is

options.A: It can not be applied to non-differentiable functions.
options.B: It can not be applied to non-continuous functions.
options.D: It runs reasonably slow for multiple linear regression.

questions.answer_explanation: Grid search is computationally intensive as it evaluates every combination of hyperparameters across a predefined grid, leading to slow performance, especially with the increased complexity and dimensionality in multiple linear regression scenarios.

questions.stem_text: The number of test examples needed to get statistically significant results should be _

options.A: Larger if the error rate is larger.
options.B: Larger if the error rate is smaller.
options.C: Smaller if the error rate is smaller.

questions.answer_explanation: A larger number of test examples is needed to achieve statistically significant results when the error rate is smaller because a lower error rate requires more samples to reliably detect the true performance of the model and ensure that the observed results are not due to random chance.

questions.stem_text: Underfitting occurs when a model fails to capture the underlying patterns in the training data and cannot generalize to new data.
questions.answer_explanation: Underfitting occurs when a model is too simplistic to represent the complexity of the training data, leading to poor performance both on the training set and when applied to new, unseen data.

questions.stem_text: Linear hard-margin SVM can only be used when the training data are linearly separable.
questions.answer_explanation: Linear hard-margin SVM requires that the data can be perfectly separated by a hyperplane without any misclassifications, which is only possible when the training data are linearly separable.

questions.stem_text: DCGANs utilize self-attention mechanisms to enhance the stability of their training process.
questions.answer_explanation: DCGANs (Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks) do not use self-attention mechanisms; instead, they rely on convolutional layers and batch normalization to improve training stability.

questions.stem_text: Sampling with replacement in bagging eliminates the risk of overfitting completely for all classifiers used.
questions.answer_explanation: Sampling with replacement in bagging reduces overfitting by increasing diversity among the models but does not eliminate it entirely, as individual classifiers can still overfit to their respective training samples.

questions.stem_text: Calculating P(H|E, F) requires knowledge of P(E|H) and P(F|H) alone.
questions.answer_explanation: The statement is false because calculating P(H|E, F) also requires knowledge of P(E, F|H) and P(E, F) to apply Bayes' theorem correctly.
